'''Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei Music Collection''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|結晶塔|けっしょうとう}}の{{tt|帝王|ていおう}} ピチューとピカチュウ ミュジックコレクション''' ''Emperor of the Crystal Tower – Pichu and Pikachu Music Collection'') is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 3rd Pokémon movie, ''[[M03|Spell of the Unown: Entei]]''. It was released in Japan on July 8, 2000.
